entries.short: The communist uprising in Revachol, about fifty years before the game. It overthrew the monarchy.
entries.details: Communist revolutionaries took the city from its royal government and founded the Commune. Their victory was short-lived: the Coalition of foreign nations invaded and crushed it. The Revolution is still a living memory for older characters, and the scars (bullet holes, ruins, grudges) are everywhere.
entries.inspiredBy: The Paris Commune of 1871 and the revolutions of the 20th century.

entries.short: The short-lived communist government of Revachol after the Revolution. Its members were Communards.
entries.details: The Commune ruled Revachol until the Coalition invaded and destroyed it. Its defeat shaped the city's present: foreign rule, poverty, and an RCM police force improvised from citizens.
entries.inspiredBy: The Paris Commune of 1871, whose members were also called Communards and which was also crushed by force.

entries.short: Supporters of Revachol's old monarchy, which the communist revolution overthrew.
entries.details: Some old veterans, like René Arnoux, fought for the king against the revolutionaries and still hold onto that loyalty.
